name: indicator_id
description: FDIC mnemonic of the line item
observations: Primary key; the value stored in financials_indicator
description_pt: Mnemônico do FDIC para a rubrica
description_en: FDIC mnemonic of the line item
description_es: Mnemónico de la FDIC para la partida

name: name
description: Readable name of the line item
observations: Derived from the FDIC title, which is published in capitals
description_en: Readable name of the line item

name: description
description: Definition of the line item as published by the FDIC
observations: Empty for the line items the FDIC documents by title only
description_pt: Definição da rubrica conforme publicada pelo FDIC
description_en: Definition of the line item as published by the FDIC
description_es: Definición de la partida según la publica la FDIC

name: measurement_unit
description: Unit the value is expressed in: USD, percent or unit
observations: Classified from the FDIC title and description. Dollar amounts are converted from thousands to whole dollars at cleaning time
description_pt: Unidade em que o valor é expresso: USD, percent ou unit
description_en: Unit the value is expressed in: USD, percent or unit
description_es: Unidad en que se expresa el valor: USD, percent o unit

name: is_ratio
description: Whether the line item is a ratio computed by the FDIC
description_pt: Indica se a rubrica é um índice calculado pelo FDIC
description_en: Whether the line item is a ratio computed by the FDIC
description_es: Indica si la partida es un índice calculado por la FDIC

name: is_quarterly
description: Whether the line item covers the quarter rather than the year to date
observations: Income-statement items are year-to-date unless flagged here; the FDIC marks the quarterly variants with a Q suffix
description_pt: Indica se a rubrica se refere ao trimestre e não ao acumulado do ano
description_en: Whether the line item covers the quarter rather than the year to date
description_es: Indica si la partida se refiere al trimestre y no al acumulado del año

name: is_flag
description: Whether the line item is a binary flag rather than a measure
observations: Flags are excluded from the financials table and appear in financials_indicator as 0 or 1
description_pt: Indica se a rubrica é um marcador binário e não uma medida
description_en: Whether the line item is a binary flag rather than a measure
description_es: Indica si la partida es un marcador binario y no una medida

name: financials_column
description: Name of the matching column in the financials table
observations: Empty for the line items that are only available in financials_indicator
description_pt: Nome da coluna correspondente na tabela financials
description_en: Name of the matching column in the financials table
description_es: Nombre de la columna correspondiente en la tabla financials
